lines.speaker: husband
lines.text: I'll sweep the hearth if you investigate the mysterious scratching under the porch.

lines.speaker: wife
lines.text: Last time you investigated a scratching, you befriended a badger.

lines.speaker: husband
lines.text: His name was Barnaby and he had excellent table manners.

lines.speaker: wife
lines.text: You were snoring so loudly the ceiling rafters were vibrating.

lines.speaker: husband
lines.text: I wasn't snoring. I was harmonizing with the wind in the chimney.

lines.speaker: wife
lines.text: The wind doesn't gasp for air every thirty seconds.

lines.speaker: partner_a
lines.text: You stole my side of the bench by the fire.

lines.speaker: partner_b
lines.text: I was merely keeping the cushion warm so you wouldn't suffer.

lines.speaker: partner_a
lines.text: Such selfless devotion. Now scoot over.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I drew our family with charcoal on this slate!

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Oh, that's lovely! Why does your father look like a hairy turnip with legs?

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Because realism is important to my artistic vision.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I can't go to sleep yet. The shadow on the wall looks like a goblin with a fork.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: That is literally just your coat hanging on the wooden peg.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Then my coat has hostile intentions.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Eat three more roasted carrots and you can go play in the yard.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: What if I eat two and compromise by looking very healthy?

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Three carrots, or I tell the village elder you hate farming.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Where are your second pair of wool socks?

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: They are currently serving as winter mittens for my pet frog.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: The frog that lives outside in the mud?

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: He gets drafty toes!

lines.speaker: housemate_a
lines.text: Someone ate the bowl of dried berries I left covered on the shelf.

lines.speaker: housemate_b
lines.text: They were sitting there looking lonely and vulnerable to mold.

lines.speaker: housemate_a
lines.text: I covered them with a wooden plate and wrote 'MINE' in chalk.

lines.speaker: housemate_b
lines.text: I thought it said 'MINT'. I was testing for herbal freshness.

lines.speaker: housemate_a
lines.text: Why is the window shutter propped open when it's freezing outside?

lines.speaker: housemate_b
lines.text: The cabin smelled like boiled cabbage.

lines.speaker: housemate_a
lines.text: Now it smells like boiled cabbage and frostbite.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Nobody here to steal the wool blanket. I am the undisputed emperor of this mattress.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Eating stew directly out of the cooking pot with a big spoon. Civilization has peaked.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Spider in the corner: you eat the pantry moths, I don't crush you with a boot. An honorable treaty.
